unified_features.name: Notes
unified_features.rationale: Both apps do note CRUD with different storage, ids and ordering; one Note module avoids two note stores.
unified_features.behaviour: Create (201), list, read, update (title/body only) and delete (204) notes stored in SQLite. Title required (1-200 chars), body may be empty. List order: pinned first, then newest created first. Unknown id returns 404 JSON error.
unified_features.improvements: Persistent storage replaces Jotter's in-memory Map; update whitelists fields (no mass assignment); updated_at refreshed on every edit; 404 instead of a crash on unknown ids.

unified_features.name: Tags
unified_features.rationale: QuickNotes' shared tags chosen over Jotter's free-text labels (same job; tags are de-duplicated, reusable and filterable).
unified_features.behaviour: Add a tag to a note by name (trimmed, case-insensitive unique, get-or-create); remove a tag from a note; list tags; filter notes by tag. Adding the same tag twice is a no-op.
unified_features.improvements: Unique (note_id, tag_id) pair; remove-tag endpoint; tag filter on list.

unified_features.name: Search
unified_features.rationale: QuickNotes' title-and-body search is a superset of Jotter's title-only search.
unified_features.behaviour: GET search with q returns notes whose title or body contains q, case-insensitive, pinned first then newest. Empty q returns 400.
unified_features.improvements: Escape LIKE wildcards; explicit case-insensitivity; validate q.

unified_features.name: Markdown preview
unified_features.rationale: Only QuickNotes has it; useful for a Markdown notes app.
unified_features.behaviour: GET a note's preview returns its body rendered from Markdown to sanitised HTML.
unified_features.improvements: Sanitise rendered HTML (strip scripts, event handlers, javascript: URLs).

unified_features.name: Pinning
unified_features.rationale: Only Jotter has it; complements the list.
unified_features.behaviour: Pin and unpin a note; pinned notes list first in the note list and in search results.

unified_features.name: Markdown export
unified_features.rationale: Only Jotter has it; keeps notes portable.
unified_features.behaviour: GET export returns a JSON list of {file, text}: one Markdown file per note, file name = slugified title plus short id, text = front matter (title, tags, created, updated) and body.
unified_features.improvements: Safe, unique file names; tags in front matter. Zip download left as an open question.
